tasks.label: Clean
tasks.detail: make distclean: remove all build output and configure results
args: if [ -f Makefile ]; then make distclean; else echo 'Nothing to clean'; fi

tasks.label: Release Build
tasks.detail: Optimised build (-O3); reconfigures first if the tree is set up for debug
args: set -e; if [ ! -f src/Makefile ] || grep -q '^CFLAGS =.*-D_DEBUG' src/Makefile; then if [ -f Makefile ]; then make distclean; fi; ./autogen.sh; ./configure; fi; make -j$(nproc)

tasks.label: Debug Build
tasks.detail: Unoptimised build (-O0 -ggdb -D_DEBUG); reconfigures first if the tree is set up for release
args: set -e; if [ ! -f src/Makefile ] || ! grep -q '^CFLAGS =.*-D_DEBUG' src/Makefile; then if [ -f Makefile ]; then make distclean; fi; ./autogen.sh; ./configure --enable-debug; fi; make -j$(nproc)

tasks.label: Open Config File
tasks.detail: Open the b-em config that b-em actually uses (~/.config/b-em/b-em.cfg); close b-em before editing or it will overwrite your changes on exit
